warnings: No obvious status-quo or baseline alternative was found.
metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: AI Model Deployment and Validation Strategy
decision.domain: Artificial intelligence, statistics, model risk, and responsible deployment
decision.owner: Model risk and product governance committee
decision.question: Choose a deployment strategy for a high-impact prediction model under calibration, subgroup-error, drift, capacity, and contestability constraints.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

static-release.label: Static model release
static-release.description: Deploy the current model and threshold with periodic aggregate reporting.

monitored-calibrated.label: Calibrated model with live monitoring
monitored-calibrated.description: Recalibrate on held-out data, monitor drift and subgroup errors, and route uncertain cases for review.

full-human-review.label: Model plus universal human review
full-human-review.description: Use scores only for prioritization and require a trained reviewer for every consequential action.

shadow-human.label: Shadow deployment before bounded automation
shadow-human.description: Run the model without decision authority, collect prospective errors, then automate only validated low-risk strata.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; predictive performance does not establish the effect of acting on a score.
limitations: The score data are synthetic and do not demonstrate production generalization.
Group error gaps depend on a single illustrative threshold.
Human-review quality and feedback loops are simplified.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A production decision requires time-separated external validation, leakage review, documented threshold costs, and post-deployment incident governance.
Subgroup diagnostics should include uncertainty and sample size, not just point estimates.
